changeinfo.changes: - While using Remote Play, Turn() and Undo are now mapped to R1 and L1, respectively - Fixed rare crash that could occur in Stability Test 1 - Fixed rare crash that could occur using the Get() function - Fixed issue where user would sometimes run offscreen during Turn() execution - Fixed issues where user could not advance through certain situations with certain function loadouts - Fixed issue where user could not use multiple instances of a function in Turn() in Recursion mode - Fixed issue in Bracket Towers where a maintenance door would not open in rare cases - Fixed issue where user could fail Speed Test 1 while completing it - Fixed an exploit where users could win Stability Test 1 by using Turn() immediately - Optimized visual FX for Jaunt() + Crash() + Spark() for performance - 'Snapshot' Process no longer physically invulnerable while dodging - In Speed Test 2, replaced fixed function Flood() with Load() + Jaunt() - Fixed several minor textual errors - Updated a profile data error message to be more accurate.
